_readme: SOURCE-DERIVED layout model. Numbers were read by hand out of the cited source lines (src.file:line + quote). It does NOT render Roblox, was not run in Studio and does not prove input works. kind=unknown elements are static Studio frames (not in the repo) and are excluded from every overlap result; kind=assumed elements are probes reported separately and never counted.

meta.coordinateSystem: Physical pixels, origin top-left of the window (Camera.ViewportSize = W x H). A ScreenGui with IgnoreGuiInset=true spans (0,0)-(W,H); with IgnoreGuiInset=false it spans (0,inset)-(W,H) and its scale values use H-inset.
meta.insetAssumption: GuiInset (top bar) = 36 px on desktop viewports, 58 px on phone viewports (task instruction; Roblox reports different values per platform/app version - override with --inset-desktop/--inset-phone).

formulas.size: px = scale * parentSize + offset; RelativeYY uses the parent HEIGHT for both axes; then UISizeConstraint Min/Max per axis; then UIAspectRatioConstraint (FitWithinMaxSize: shrink to the aspect inside the box); then UIScale.
formulas.touch: phone viewports (844x390, 667x375, 932x430, 390x844) are modelled as TouchEnabled and not KeyboardEnabled; desktop viewports as keyboard/mouse
formulas.touchTargets: Only checked on touch viewports. 44 px is the target; 40 px is accepted for elements flagged denseOk (UILayout.MIN_TOUCH_DENSE) and reported separately.

scenarios.lobby_idle: Lobby, on foot, nothing open, no contract. Small screens: OFFERS toggle only (column folded).
scenarios.lobby_offers_open: Lobby, nothing else open; on small screens the player tapped OFFERS so the card column is open.
scenarios.lobby_contract_pill: Lobby with a HELP REQUEST pill pending (offer exists, no job, popup closed).
scenarios.contract_announcement: HELP REQUEST announcement popup up (offers hide; pill hidden).
scenarios.garage_offer_card: In the garage, a pedestal OfferCard open.
scenarios.garage_equip_window: In the garage, the equip window (GarageWindow) open.
scenarios.garage_inspect: In the garage, a neighbour's Inspect panel open.
scenarios.driving: Seated in own plow: EXIT / DRIFT / RECOVER visible, nothing else open.
scenarios.driving_offers_open: Driving after the player had opened the OFFERS list on a small screen (desktop: column always shown).
scenarios.driving_contract_tracker: Driving with an active job tracker.
scenarios.driving_treasure_toast: Driving; a treasure reward toast and the dig-combo meter are up (transient, coincide in normal play).
scenarios.tutorial_step_help_open: Replay lesson step (card in the top slot) with the HELP menu opened by tapping the HELP pill (no guard against this in the pill handler).
scenarios.tutorial_card_low_help_open: Same, but the card was moved to its lowered slot because the target sits under the top slot.
scenarios.help_menu_open: HELP menu open on the lobby with a contract pill pending.
scenarios.travel_menu_open: TRAVEL panel (RNGGui.Panels.Travel) open; its rect is a static Studio frame (unknown).
scenarios.offer_details_open: A paid-offer card was tapped: OfferDetails popup open.
scenarios.offers_mini_plows_open: MINI PLOWS panel open while the offer cards are showing (small: column expanded).
scenarios.offers_inspect_open: A neighbour's Inspect panel open while the offer cards are showing (small: column expanded).
scenarios.offers_egg_screen_open: Verity egg DETAILS screen open while the offer cards are showing (small: column expanded).
scenarios.boss_pill_contract_tracker: Frost King event live (JOIN pill) while a contract job tracker runs.
scenarios.boss_fight: In the Frost King fight, driving: boss bar + personal HP panel.
scenarios.arena_prejoin: Bumper Arena island, not joined (JOIN MATCH visible).
scenarios.arena_match: Bumper Arena island, joined and driving (BOOST / BRACE visible).
scenarios.boss_fight_contract_tracker: Frost King fight (boss bar + personal panel up) while a contract tracker is also active. Added 2026-10-08 after review: the touch boss bar is >= 56 px high.

allowList.reason: A child sits inside (or deliberately pokes out of) its parent: buttons on a card, the OP! badge on an offer card. Only sibling and cross-parent overlaps are reported. Overlaps of a badge with a THIRD element are still counted.

ruleDocs.helpY: AFTER HelpPill: y = max(0, floor(min(0.835 H, H - (2 h + gap + 16)))), h = pill height after its UISizeConstraint, gap = max(6, floor(0.18 h)).
ruleDocs.helpMenuAboveHelp: AFTER HelpMenu: bottom edge = HelpPill top - 6 (anchor 0,1).
ruleDocs.travelDock: TravelButton = HelpPill size (floored); top = HelpPill bottom + max(6, floor(0.18 h)); left = HelpPill left. Follows HELP's live rect.
ruleDocs.offers: Offer column / OFFERS toggle: left = floor(HELP right + max(10, 0.35 HELP.h)); bottom = floor(max(HELP bottom, TRAVEL bottom when TRAVEL is visible)); the opened column on a small screen is lifted 48 px (anchor 0,1).
ruleDocs.offerPopupSmall: AFTER OfferDetails on small screens: width = max(300, min(0.8 W, colLeft - 16)), centre x = max(colLeft/2, w/2 + 8), height 0.9 H (min 300), colLeft = W - 8 - max(130, floor(0.17 W)).
ruleDocs.popupTop: PopupStack: a stacked popup's top = max(0.11 H, tutorial card bottom + 18 when the card top is above 0.4 H, AFTER also touch Frost King Me bottom + 8 when it is in the top half). AFTER touch HELP REQUEST width max = floor(clamp(2*(colLeft - 8 - W/2), 320, 620)).
ruleDocs.touchColumn: AFTER touch DRIFT(1) / DRIVE-EXIT(2) / RECOVER(3): right edge W-8, width max(130, floor(0.17 W)), 44 high, 6 px gaps, hidden members collapse, column bottom = jump button top - 8.
ruleDocs.fkPillTouch: AFTER touch Frost King pill: top = max(0, floor(min(0.19 H, colTop - 8 - 56) + 0.5)), colTop = jumpTop - 8 - 144, right edge 0.988 W.
ruleDocs.fkMeTouch: AFTER touch Frost King Me card: top = floor(boss bar bottom + 6 + 0.5), centred.
ruleDocs.contractSlot: AFTER pill/tracker share one slot (anchor 1,0): right = 0.925 W (touch min(0.8 W, colLeft - 8)), top = 0.27 Hg (touch 0.16 Hg) pushed below the Frost King pill / top-half Me card (+8); touch top = min(top, stripTop - 8 - 140), stripTop = Hg - 92 (fallback; live UPGRADES top unknown); touch tracker height = floor(max(140, min(clamp(0.36 Hg,140,230), stripTop - 8 - top))). Hg = H - inset.
ruleDocs.inspectFit: AFTER Inspect panel: (0.64, 0.92) when small or the normal panel would be < 340 px tall, else (0.42, 0.5); aspect 1.25.
ruleDocs.uiScaleViewport: MINI PLOWS panel UIScale = clamp(min(W/420, H/330), 0.6, 1.3).
ruleDocs.toastShownTouch: AFTER touch treasure toast: right edge W-(colW+24), UIScale clamp((W-(colW+24)-8)/300, 0.5, 1), centre y 0.6 H.
ruleDocs.treePill: UPGRADES progress pill top = GuiInset.Y + 8 in an IgnoreGuiInset gui.
ruleDocs.arenaLeave/arenaPaint: AFTER touch bottom-left stack (anchor 0,1 at 0.012 W, 0.6 Hg): LEAVE bottom, PAINT above it with an 8 px gap; widths max(140, 0.17 W) / max(96, 0.12 W).
ruleDocs.arenaBoost/arenaBrace/arenaStatus: AFTER touch: BOOST 88 px, right edge jumpLeft-12, bottom Hg-16; BRACE 72 px, 8 px left of BOOST; Status left aligned, width max(0, min(0.5 W, jumpLeft - 196 - 0.012 W)).
ruleDocs.jumpProbe: ASSUMED Roblox jump button: left/top from UILayout.jumpLeftTop's fallback, size 70 or 120 px from memory.
ruleDocs.stripProbe: ASSUMED UPGRADES strip fallback band (H-92..H, 0.5 W +/- 166).

notModelled: Tutorial spotlight dims, hole, rings, arrows and tag (recomputed per frame from the live target rect).
ContractGui.Toast, PlowShopGui.Toast, other PopupStack toasts, Frost King announcement, treasure Mythic announce (popup column; only the contract announcement is modelled).
OfferCard confirm dialog and reserved-shelf strip, Arena results/intro cards, Dig callout, Frost King Msg/Hint/Reward, drive Msg label.
SnowPrompt billboards and tutorial world markers (world-space BillboardGuis).
Roblox thumbstick, chat, top-bar buttons (core gui, not in the repo).
TravelButton BEFORE is found by a 60 s scan for a bottom-left 'HELP' button; the model assumes it finds the PlowTutorial HelpPill.
